title: AIT Home Delivery adds two Mercedes-Benz eSprinter electric vans
summary:
AIT Home Delivery, a wholly owned subsidiary of AIT Worldwide Logistics, has added two Mercedes-Benz eSprinter electric vans to its delivery fleet as part of its strategy to reduce emissions from final-mile operations.

Supplied by NRG Riverside, the fully electric vehicles will operate on urban delivery routes from AIT’s Northampton and Enfield facilities in the UK.

The company said the vans are suited to urban distribution because of their zero tailpipe emissions, low noise levels, range and payload capacity.
